notWebPage.message: This is not a web page Sara can read.

extName.message: Sara: your own AI in the browser

storeDescription.message:
Sara is a personal AI companion that you run on your own server or PC. This extension connects your browser to YOUR Sara, and to nothing else.

On the page you are on:
• Ask Sara about this page: she reads the page's text and answers in the popup. Continue the chat in Sara with one click.
• Summarize: a short summary of the page.
• Save page to Library: the page's text and address are kept in her Library as a document.
• Fill this form: Sara proposes values from My details. You see every field, untick or change any, then approve. Nothing is typed before you approve, and the form is never sent for you.
• Right-click selected text to ask about it, or right-click a page to save it.
• Off on this site: one switch, and nothing from that site is read or sent.

Privacy and safety:
• Data goes only to the Sara server you pair with. No analytics, no ads, no other servers, no remote code.
• A page is read only when you click. Nothing runs in the background.
• Never filled: passwords, payment cards, one-time codes and ID numbers.
• Pairing uses a short code you approve inside Sara. Disconnect in the popup, or sign it out in Sara, and its access ends at once.

You need a Sara server (free and open source). Learn more and set one up at https://github.com/farena-ai/sara
